context: The hag has just shed her Blushing Mermaid disguise to reveal her true form. Off‑screen the player already tracked down Vanra and returned her to her mother Lora — Vanra is present but traumatized and mostly catatonic. Auntie Ethel mockingly claims she “ate” Vanra and insists the child now sits in her belly to be birthed and trained as a hag; whether literal or a cruel taunt, the statement is meant to horrify and manipulate. She swings between theatrical cruelty and cold, calculating demands (urging the player to walk away or accept her terms), while the player can press for the child’s surrender or resort to violence; the exchange is also colored by the fact the player previously attacked her while she was in disguise.
